WITH order_lines AS (
    SELECT id, order_id, product_id, qty as order_qty
    FROM orderlines
    WHERE order_id = 423
),
order_cumulative AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        order_qty,
        SUM(order_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY id) as cum_qty
    FROM order_lines
    WHERE order_id = 423
),
inventory_sorted AS (
    SELECT 
        p.id as purchase_id,
        p.purchased,
        p.product_id,
        i.qty as inventory_qty,
        l.id as location_id,
        l.aisle,
        l.position,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY p.product_id 
            ORDER BY p.purchased, p.qty, i.location_id
        ) as rn
    FROM purchases p
    JOIN inventory i ON p.id = i.purchase_id
    JOIN locations l ON i.location_id = l.id
    WHERE l.warehouse = 1
    AND p.product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM order_lines WHERE order_id = 423)
),
picking AS (
    SELECT 
        ir.product_id,
        ir.location_id,
        ir.aisle,
        ir.position,
        ir.inventory_qty,
        co.cum_qty,
        ir.rn,
        LAG(ir.rn) OVER (PARTITION BY ir.product_id ORDER BY ir.rn) as prev_rn,
        SUM(ir.inventory_qty) OVER (
            PARTITION BY ir.product_id 
            ORDER BY ir.rn 
            ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
        ) as cum_inv
    FROM inventory_sorted ir
    JOIN order_cumulative co ON ir.product_id = co.product_id
)
SELECT product_id, location_id, aisle, position, inventory_qty, cum_qty, rn, prev_rn, cum_inv
FROM picking
ORDER BY product_id, rn
